title: thymus hirtus subsp. tenuifolius
intro: Thymus hirtus subsp. tenuifolius, commonly known as Mountain Thyme, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Thyme include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce stress and anxiety, and exhibit anti-cancer and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents present in Mountain Thyme include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
